_comment: OWNER POLICY 2026-11-10: tests are RETIRED — unit first, then UI tests too ('get rid of them completely'). Both floors are 0 and can never block: the planner may still MEASURE what a test suite would have covered, and the number is informational only. Nothing in the team requires, writes or runs a test suite; a screen is proven by the ux-flow audit (a vision model walking the journey on a device) and code by the compile gate. A project may override profile['coverage'] {unit_floor, ui_floor}, but raising a floor re-introduces a gate the owner has removed.
